articles.title: 10 2000s Sitcoms Better Than Anything Made Today
articles.summary: The article suggests that despite the vast availability of comedy TV in the streaming era, sitcoms from the 2000s continue to be the most rewatched, quoted, and culturally persistent. It highlights the lasting impact of content from that period, suggesting quality and cultural relevance can transcend modern volume and accessibility offered by technology.

articles.title: Putin predicts European ‘swine’ backing Ukraine will lose power
articles.summary: Russian President Vladimir Putin reaffirmed Russia's mission to "liberate its historic lands," indicating no intention of backing down from the conflict. He also expressed confidence that European governments supporting Kyiv would eventually lose power. This speech highlights Russia's unwavering resolve and its long-term geopolitical outlook regarding the ongoing situation in Ukraine.

articles.title: Rafales to strengthen long range strike capabilities: Navy Chief Admiral Tripathi
articles.summary: Indian Navy Chief Admiral Dinesh K Tripathi stressed the Navy's commitment to bolstering integral ship-borne aviation capabilities. He specifically mentioned an ongoing defence procurement deal with France, indicating strategic efforts to modernise naval assets. This focus aims to enhance the fleet's operational readiness and strengthen India's maritime security, crucial for regional power projection.

articles.title: India, UAE troops to take part in joint military exercise in Abu Dhabi from December 18-30
articles.summary: India and the UAE militaries are set to conduct a joint exercise from December 18-30, focusing on enhancing interoperability and strengthening defence cooperation. For SSB aspirants, this bilateral engagement highlights the importance of joint training in modern warfare, fostering mutual understanding and operational readiness between friendly nations for regional security.

articles.title: Kirby Air Riders Game Review
articles.summary: The year 2025 is poised to be significant for the gaming industry, with anticipated releases like a brand new 'Mario Kart World' and 'Sonic Racing: CrossWorlds.' These major video game launches are generating substantial excitement, marking 2025 as a landmark year for gaming enthusiasts and showcasing advancements in interactive entertainment technology.

articles.title: Brighten Your Real-Time Camera Feeds with Low Light Boost
articles.summary: Instagram has introduced a new "Night Mode" feature, enabling users to capture stunning low-light photos. This technological advancement significantly enhances mobile photography capabilities, allowing for high-quality still images even in challenging environments. Such innovations continuously improve user experience and push the boundaries of smartphone camera performance, making professional-grade photography more accessible to all users.

articles.title: German MPs approve 50 bn euros in military purchases
articles.summary: German lawmakers have approved a substantial increase in military spending, allocating approximately 50 billion euros ($59 billion). This significant move reflects Germany's intent to bolster its defence capabilities, primarily driven by the perceived growing threat from Russia. The decision signals a major shift in Berlin's defence policy, adapting to evolving geopolitical dynamics and security concerns in Europe.
